items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was with Raeburn and the lead trumpet player was marvelous, Dale Pierce was his name.

ctx.x: With the same kind of end?

Yeah, yeah, very. He came and sat in one night with Joe Venuti, when I was with him, he had been with Joe years before that and I said, “Wow, who’s this guy,” everybody was telling me about Tommy Allison and then we became very fast friends. He was with Raeburn and the lead trumpet player was marvelous, Dale Pierce was his name.
